conf.description: Forcepoint DLP incident, syslog/CEF (ArcSight predefined format), per recommendations.direct.cribl. Regex-splits CEF header+extension (extension parsed with lookahead-bounded capture, not naive kv split, since msg can contain unescaped spaces). Keeps only Name=DLP Syslog records without riskScore (case records share that Name header - see the risk-ranking-case pipeline). Derives event.outcome from action, routes suser/duser/sourceHost/destinationHosts channel- or shape-aware, splits comma lists, sets _time from timeStamp (Audit Quality SIEM) or falls back to the syslog header time.

conf.comment: Forcepoint DLP incident, syslog/CEF (ArcSight predefined format), per recommendations.direct.cribl. Regex-splits CEF header+extension (extension parsed with lookahead-bounded capture, not naive kv split, since msg can contain unescaped spaces). Keeps only Name=DLP Syslog records without riskScore (case records share that Name header - see the risk-ranking-case pipeline). Derives event.outcome from action, routes suser/duser/sourceHost/destinationHosts channel- or shape-aware, splits comma lists, sets _time from timeStamp (Audit Quality SIEM) or falls back to the syslog header time.

functions.description: Split the 7 pipe-delimited CEF header fields from the extension string.

Extract every CEF extension key=value pair. Non-greedy value + lookahead on the next key= (or end of string) so multi-word values like msg are not cut at the first space, which a naive kv splitter would do.
Keep only incident records; case records share the 'DLP Syslog' Name header but carry riskScore.
Batch-rename every status:mapped field to its ECS target.

Derive event.outcome (documented actions are all completed enforcements, never failures); relocate unmapped fields to forcepoint.dlp.*; split comma lists; branch suser/duser/sourceHost by channel or value shape.

conf.code: if (typeof destinationHosts !== 'undefined') { var __parts = destinationHosts.split(/,\s*/); var __ips = []; var __doms = []; for (var __i = 0; __i < __parts.length; __i++) { if (/^\d{1,3}(\.\d{1,3}){3}$/.test(__parts[__i])) { __ips.push(__parts[__i]); } else { __doms.push(__parts[__i]); } } __e.destination = __e.destination || {}; __e.destination.address = __parts; if (__ips.length) { __e.destination.ip = __ips; } if (__doms.length) { __e.destination.domain = __doms; } delete __e.destinationHosts; }

functions.description: Audit Quality SIEM only: split destinationHosts and type-test each element into destination.ip / destination.domain alongside destination.address. Per-element typing needs statements, so this uses code rather than eval.
Fallback event time from the syslog header; the plain CEF format carries no body timestamp.
Set _time from timeStamp (Audit Quality SIEM; assumed UTC, see README) when present, else keep the syslog-header time; tag event.dataset.
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
